notes: QA-01 on a vertical short video, in any kit. One request per frame carries all 7 defect questions and both gates, on the whole frame, no mask. The kit's look reaches the questions only through `context`, the manifest's qa_context.short text. High p = problem. caption_on_face counts only when both gates reach thresholds.jev.gate. Triage, never a ship gate. Any wording change bumps the version.

instructions.question: In `frame`, is any piece of text partly covered by a panel, card, window or other element placed on top of it, or showing faintly through a semi-transparent layer?
instructions.not_for: Text that is fully visible even if small; text inside a screenshot that is simply cropped by its own window frame.

criteria.true: Some letters are hidden or overlapped by another element, or ghost text shows through a panel.
criteria.false: Every piece of text is fully visible and nothing sits on top of it.

cut_off_edge.instructions: In `frame`, is any text, card or window cut off by the outer edge of the video frame?

criteria.true: Part of a word, card or window runs past the edge of the frame and is missing.
criteria.false: Everything meant to be read is fully inside the frame; full-bleed footage or background reaching the edge is fine.

caption_on_face.instructions: In `frame`, does caption text sit on top of the speaker's mouth or chin?

criteria.true: Caption words overlap the lower part of the speaker's face.
criteria.false: No speaker is visible, or the caption sits clear of the mouth and chin.

instructions.question: In `frame`, is a large block of the picture, roughly a third or more, empty background in a place where a window, card, footage or the speaker would be expected?
instructions.not_for: A plain strip that only holds a caption line; a plain margin around a window or card.

criteria.true: A big area that should hold a window, card, footage or the speaker shows only plain background, as if something failed to appear.
criteria.false: Every window, card, footage and speaker area is filled; the plain space around or below a caption line is normal.

overlapping_panels.instructions: In `frame`, are three or more cards, windows or panels stacked on top of each other, covering one another?

overlay_on_controls.instructions: In `frame`, does a small label, pill or badge sit on top of a window's title bar, tabs or buttons, covering them?

instructions.question: Would a viewer on a phone struggle to read the main on-screen text in `frame` at a glance, because it is tiny, low-contrast or on a busy background?
instructions.not_for: Small text inside a screenshot that is not the point of the shot.

face_visible.instructions: Is a person's face visible in `frame`?

caption_visible.instructions: Does `frame` show a line of caption text, i.e. spoken words written on screen?
